result.title: Don't Waste the Population: Post-Anneal Refinement for Combinatorial Optimization
result.summary: Parallel annealers generate diverse candidate solutions; yet, conventional post-processing typically refines only the best, leaving much of the population's potential untapped. We introduce Iterative Path-Relinking Polish (I-PRP), a deterministic, training-free method that exploits this diversity to discover better solutions without modifying the underlying annealing process. I-PRP selects promising candidates, explores cost-guided paths between locally optimized solutions, and refines intermediate states to uncover better local minima. Newly discovered improvements are iteratively incorporated into the population, enabling further exploration. We theoretically guarantee that I-PRP never degrades solution quality relative to conventional single-candidate polishing on the same population and converges in finitely many iterations. Experiments across challenging combinatorial optimization benchmarks, including MaxCut, MaxClique, and graph coloring, demonstrate substantial improvements in several instances. Paired evaluations confirm non-degradation, while matched-runtime comparisons show that exploiting existing population diversity can outperform additional annealing. These results establish I-PRP as an effective and reliable refinement strategy for parallel annealing.

AI.brief_summary: 提出无需训练的确定性后处理方法 I-PRP，在并行退火产生的候选解群体中选取有潜力的解，沿代价引导路径在局部最优解之间探索并精炼中间状态，并迭代把改进解并回群体。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「保留并利用多个候选而非只精炼最佳、在候选间路径上精炼中间状态」的思路，可能与 LVR 中多 latent 假设的保留、筛选与状态间插值精炼问题相通，供核查其选择准则是否能迁移到视觉证据候选的取舍。
